definitions.explanation: occurring often or at short intervals

examples.japanese: {頻繁|ひんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻繁|ひんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents occur frequently on this road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頻繁|ひんぱん}な⟦やり{取|と}り→やり取り：07702_yaritori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, I'm tired from frequent exchanges with him.

notes:
{頻繁|ひんぱん} is a na-adjective meaning frequent or repeated, implying things happen at short intervals.

FORMS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な〜: frequent (modifier)
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: frequently (adverb — this is the most common form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧: frequent updates
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}な⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧: frequent contact
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use frequently
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: to occur frequently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: often (casual, everyday)
- ⟦しばしば→しばしば：02365_shibashiba⟧: often (literary, written)
- ⟦たびたび→たびたび：00397_tabitabi⟧: repeatedly, time and again
- ⟦ひっきりなしに→ひっきりなしに：20411_hikkirinashini⟧: incessantly, without pause

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ is more natural. {頻繁|ひんぱん} is common in news, reports, and written Japanese.
